note: Element ids match the id attributes in the matching .svg file.

elements.api-token: Your session token — the console signs requests as you
elements.api-send: Send — this is a real request against your own data

elements.ch-stat-2-value: Replies that matched no branch — the number to watch
elements.ch-stat-3-value: The last step reached — where it stopped
elements.ch-ev-2-flag: The reply that did not match, and what was expected

elements.cl-unsynced: Not identified yet — a ~ before the name, dashed ring
elements.cl-unsynced-0-connect: Connect — links a bot (agent), or brings an inactive one back
elements.cl-unwanted-0-badge: Unwanted — this number asked to stop. No Connect, no sending, ever

elements.chat-header: The bot (agent) and how many messages are loaded
elements.chat-template-btn: Send a template — works when the window is closed
elements.chat-send-btn: Send free text — needs the window open

elements.ct-add: Add Bot (Agent) — starts the PING handshake
elements.ct-0-status: The bot (agent) state — active, new, draft, inactive
elements.ct-0-lang: Language used for the PING and the bot's messages

elements.designer-ribbon: Save, Publish, Import, Export, Settings, Help
elements.panel-expect: EXPECT step types — wait for a reply
elements.status-bar: Event type, interval, steps, draft/active, saved

elements.ex-0-phones: The target phones — first two, then +n
elements.ex-0-templates: How many templates were copied, and their prefix
elements.ex-0-status: pending n = the Scheduler has not picked the jobs up yet
elements.ex-0-run: Run — disabled while anything is pending

elements.lang-btn: The flag in the top bar — the language you are reading now
elements.lang-row-0-check: The tick marks the current language
elements.lang-list: Your languages only — the ones chosen in Settings
elements.lang-manage: Opens Settings → 🌍, where the list is chosen

elements.lg-email: Email and password, or a provider below
elements.lg-google: Google and GitHub sign-in — same account either way

elements.mail-title: How many senders have written to this phone
elements.mail-search: Search covers the sender, the subject and the body
elements.mail-0-sender: One row per sender, not per message
elements.mail-0-count: How many mails that sender has sent
elements.mail-0-status: Whether a scenario actually received it

screen-phone-card.title: A phone card in the phone list

elements.phone-card: The card itself — click it to open the phone
elements.rent-battery-fill: Rental battery — drains as the rental runs
elements.signal-bars: Reception: green active, grey busy, outline disconnected

elements.pd-header: The phone itself — name, number, live status
elements.pd-rent-clock: Rental countdown — only on a rented phone
elements.pd-tab-1: Bots (Agents) — who this phone can talk to

elements.plan-tab-1: The 💎 tab — 💳 Billing is next to it
elements.plan-usage: What you use against what the plan allows
elements.plan-cooling: Slots freeing up — removed bots (agents) hold theirs for 24 hours
elements.plan-change: Change plan — nothing is deleted when you go down
elements.plan-balance: What the 💳 Billing tab owes — charges minus payments
elements.plan-pay: Pay the whole balance, when you choose to

elements.pb-body: The conversation as it would happen — nothing is sent
elements.pb-msg-1-expect: What the scenario was waiting for
elements.pb-play: Play, or walk it one step at a time

elements.rent-row-1-number: The number, with a Mine or Available chip
elements.rent-row-1-verified: Whether the link to the handset is live
elements.rent-row-1-btn: Rent on an available row, End on yours

elements.sc-new: New scenario — opens the designer empty
elements.sc-0-status: draft or active — only an active one runs
elements.sc-0-contact: The bot (agent) this scenario talks to

elements.sh-0-next: When it fires next — the clearest sign it is really set up

elements.settings-dialog: Settings, over the screen you were on
elements.settings-tab-two-step-alert: Orange dot — this tab needs attention
elements.settings-save: One Save for all three tabs

elements.loc-lang-2: Click a language to add it — or again to remove it
elements.loc-lang-0: ★ is the interface language — it cannot be removed
elements.loc-country-table: The countries offered in every phone field
elements.loc-default-1: The country pre-selected in an empty phone field

elements.sms-0-sender: One row per sender — tap to open the conversation
elements.sms-0-count: How many messages from that sender
elements.sms-2-sender: Messages with no readable sender land here
elements.sms-search: Search covers the sender and the text

elements.tpl-filter-2: Filter by status — the counts come from the server
elements.tpl-new: New template — saves as a draft, nothing is sent yet
elements.tpl-0-status: approved is the provider's answer, not yours
elements.tpl-0-published: Published — only a published template can be used in a scenario
elements.tpl-1-actions: Editing a published template is blocked — unpublish first

elements.unw-body: One block per language — English plus the number's mother tongue
elements.unw-btn: Opening the page does nothing — only this blocks the number
elements.unw-ref: The reference to quote to support — the only way back
